title: Gami.Fied: The self-hosted, open-source gamification engine
excerpt: Turn events from your app into XP, streaks, badges, leaderboards and rewards. Self-hosted, open source, and your data stays yours.
content_html:
Open source and self-hosted · Read what is new

The gamification engine you run yourself

Turn what people do in your app into XP, streaks, badges, leaderboards, leagues and rewards. Open source, self-hosted, and your data never leaves your servers.

features in the free, open-source edition
33

API operations, each one documented
122

ready-made React components
10

How it works

Three steps from event to reward

Send events from anywhere. Gami.Fied decides what they are worth, and your players see it straight away.

  1. Step 1

    Send an event

    Your server, or the SDK in your app, tells Gami.Fied what someone did. A retry with the same idempotency key never counts twice.

    Event receivedlesson_completed · user_123

    await gami.events.track({
  userId: 'user_123',
  type: 'lesson_completed',
});

  2. Step 2

    A rule matches

    Rules you set up in the dashboard decide what it is worth. Change them any time, test them on past events, and roll back if needed.

    Rule matchedLesson reward · +50 XP

    {
  "trigger": "lesson_completed",
  "actions": [{ "type": "award_xp", "params": { "amount": 50 } }]
}

  3. Step 3

    The player is rewarded

    XP lands in their ledger, their streak grows, badges unlock and the leaderboard moves, live in your app through the SDK or React components.

    Level 7 reached12-day streak · Seven-day streak badge

    <LevelProgress />
<StreakCalendar />
<ToastHost />

See it

The dashboard in two and a half minutes

Rules, badges, streaks, leaderboards, leagues and the store, recorded from the live demo. No sound, with captions.

Read what the tour shows
  1. A language app with 36 players and a month of activity. Everything here runs on Gami.Fied.
  2. Send traffic, and events arrive the way your app would send them.
  3. Rules decide what an event is worth: XP, badges and gems.
  4. Badges unlock from rules, with how many players have each one.
  5. Daily streaks, with freezes that save a missed day.
  6. Leaderboards by period, updated as XP lands.
  7. Weekly leagues with promotion and relegation.
  8. Players spend gems in a reward store, with stock and limits.
  9. Every player, with their level, streak and history.
  10. Self-hosted and open source. Your players and their data stay on your servers.

Everything in one engine

More than points and badges

Progression, a points economy, competition, community, integrations and the controls to run it, all in the free, open-source edition.

Progression

XP, levels, streaks, achievements and challenges.

Explore progression

Economy

Currencies, wallets and a reward store.

Explore economy

Competition

Leaderboards, segments, teams and leagues.

Explore competition

Community

Friends, kudos, a feed and invites.

Explore community

Integrations

SDK, React, webhooks, connectors and plugins.

Explore integrations

Administration

Run it like the rest of your stack.

Explore administration

For developers

Five lines to your first reward

Typed SDK, plain HTTP, or drop-in React components. Pick what fits.

import { Gami } from '@gami.fied/sdk';

const gami = new Gami({ baseUrl: process.env.GAMI_API_URL, apiKey: process.env.GAMI_API_KEY });

// Rules, streaks and achievements run in the background.
await gami.events.track({
  userId: 'user_123',
  type: 'lesson_completed',
  properties: { course: 'spanish-101' },
});

  • Typed end to end

    The SDK covers every public route, with retries and clear errors.

  • Safe in the browser

    Short-lived player tokens read only that player's own data.

  • Live by default

    Toasts and leaderboards update the moment rewards land.

  • Documented API

    An OpenAPI document, tested against the real responses.

Why self-hosted

Own the engine, not just the integration

Your data stays yours

Player data, events and rewards live in your own PostgreSQL. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

No bill per user

Run it for ten players or ten million. The engine is open source and free, with no per-user pricing.

Runs with one command

Docker Compose brings up the API, worker, dashboard, PostgreSQL and Redis, with health checks and migrations.

Comparing options? See how Gami.Fied compares, including where it is weaker.

Install

Up and running in minutes

Download the release files, fill in your secrets, and start it. Upgrades are one setting.

curl -LO https://github.com/gami-fied/gami.fied/releases/latest/download/docker-compose.yml
curl -LO https://github.com/gami-fied/gami.fied/releases/latest/download/env.example
cp env.example .env   # then fill in the secrets
docker compose up -d

The dashboard opens at http://localhost:3000. Images are published for amd64 and arm64.

Give your players a reason to come back

Free and open source. Install it today, or star the project to follow along.
